tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background and the ground of lists, fields and region tiles' surroundings.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Bands, notice panels, listing badges and the filter area. Never for running text blocks wider than a panel.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface and surface-alt (15:1); primary button and owner band fill; links.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Text inside notice panels and badges, on surface-alt (9.4:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (metadata, footer, helper copy) on surface (7.2:1) and surface-alt (6.4:1). Never on ink or region fills.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on ink and on every region-* fill (all at least 5.9:1).

tokens.name: on-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on ink only (11:1), such as the owner band's body copy.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between list rows and around list containers. Decorative only: never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, selects and unselected filter chips on surface (3.8:1, meets the 3:1 rule for control boundaries).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 3px solid, offset 2px, landing on surface or surface-alt (6.6:1 and 5.9:1).

tokens.name: region-buenos-aires
tokens.usage: Buenos Aires region: tile fill, destination header band and region tag. Sea and pampas blue. Text on it: on-ink.

tokens.name: region-cordoba
tokens.usage: Córdoba region: tile fill, header band, region tag. Sierra green. Text on it: on-ink.

tokens.name: region-cuyo
tokens.usage: Cuyo region: tile fill, header band, region tag. Malbec. Text on it: on-ink.

tokens.name: region-litoral
tokens.usage: Litoral region: tile fill, header band, region tag. River teal. Text on it: on-ink.

tokens.name: region-norte
tokens.usage: Norte region: tile fill, header band, region tag. Ochre of the cerros. Text on it: on-ink.

tokens.name: region-patagonia
tokens.usage: Patagonia region: tile fill, header band, region tag. Lake and cordillera dusk. Text on it: on-ink.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Page title of home, destination and listing; set expanded (font-stretch 125%). 40px below 480px width.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Region names on tiles and the owner band title; set expanded (font-stretch 125%).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Accommodation names in lists, step titles, panel titles (h3).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Mirá cada ficha y consultá directo con el lugar.
styles.usage: Running text; keep lines under 65 characters.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Metadata, notices, footer and secondary actions.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, badges and region tags. Sentence case, never all caps.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Se abre en una pestaña nueva.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value inside a row.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, badges and inline actions.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between region tiles and between stacked fields.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Minimum side gutter on phones; panel padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Side gutter from tablet up; row padding in listing lists; panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between a heading block and its content.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on phones.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections from tablet up.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges and region tag swatches.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs and selects.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Region tiles, list containers and panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Filter chips only.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width; centered with the side gutter.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of running text.
